name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-02-02.119.5) to keep the usual second reading motion unchanged. The usual second reading motion is "*that the bill be read a second time,*" which is parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill. This vote was put after the MP for Franklin [Julie Collins](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/franklin/julie_collins) (Labor) proposed an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-02-02.114.1). ### Proposed amendment text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a second reading, the House notes the Coalition Government's continued failure to prioritise agriculture legislation and its inaction to address the agriculture workforce shortage."*
